title: Riz's Easy World Timer
description: Very simple mod that shows the total time that has passed in the top left corner of your game.
body: Very simple world timer (like 3 lines of code) that reads the amount of ticks that have passed in a world and displays it in a DD:HH:MM:SS format. This already exists for other versions, but not yet for 1.21.1 neoforge so I made this with the "Chunklocked" gamemode in mind, as played by twitch.tv/hrry
